unit_of_analysis: one change revision on one freshly initialized isolated scenario
fairness: fixed task order with counterbalancing across participants
no evaluator files or held-out answers in agent context
all attempts and safe stops retained

metrics.business_correctness: per-order source, ledger and analytics equality plus completeness at watermark
metrics.consumer_precision_recall: known evaluator world; hidden consumers retained as false negatives

stopping_rule: fixed task/time/tool/cost budget; failure and incompleteness retained
analysis: report all task outcomes and uncertainty; no claim of customer cash savings from synthetic tasks
human_comparator: requires actual engineer participation; scripted baseline is not a manual experiment
